purpose: Canonical model and artifact descriptions for grounded copilot answers.

models.training_or_source_data: market_prices table with Brent, WTI, jet fuel, jet crack spread, EIA inventories, OPEC production, volatility, equity, FX, rates, PMI, IATA passenger traffic, and freight proxies
models.limitations: PCA explains co-movement in market factors but does not prove causality. Missing components can reduce coverage.

models.training_or_source_data: stress_index components and latest market feature values
models.limitations: Regime labels are analytical clusters, not externally observed market states.

models.training_or_source_data: financial ratios, balance sheet values, market context, crack spread, supply/inventory signals, demand indicators, and modeled volatility inputs
models.limitations: Useful as a theoretical anchor but relies on estimated asset value and volatility for private/synthetic companies.

models.training_or_source_data: free-source PD training dataset with proxy distress labels, financial ratios, and expanded market context columns when available
models.limitations: Uses proxy distress labels, not internal observed bank defaults. AUC is modest, so it should be described as a realism improvement, not production-grade credit truth.

models.training_or_source_data: grid search over structural and ML PD against proxy labels
models.limitations: Blend improves Brier score versus each standalone proxy, but labels remain proxy distress labels.

models.training_or_source_data: user-entered or uploaded multi-period financial metrics and calculated ratios
models.limitations: Neutral when fewer than two comparable periods are available. It adjusts model inputs/outputs transparently; it does not replace Merton, ML PD, LGD, EAD, or EL formulas.
Uses synthetic/proxy loss severity data, so it supports explainability but is not equivalent to real recovery history.
Uses synthetic/proxy drawdown and exposure history, not internal bank utilization/default observations.

models.training_or_source_data: PD, LGD, EAD, scenario loss, financial ratios, expanded market stress, collateral, tenor, and exposure terms
models.limitations: Transparent and auditable, but policy thresholds are rules rather than learned from internal committee decisions.
